text:
Sara: heads up — Orchard/Orchid Marketplace product team pinged me. They want to onboard 3 new vendor-facing teams next month. New use case is automated PO summarization + reconciliation, and they expect ~2-3x token throughput. Asking about dedicated capacity and predictable latency SLA.

Ben: do we have any staging usage from them? any token spike history?

Sara: staging is low steady, but their demo ingestion (specially long POs) spiked embeddings+summaries. They care about p50 latency under 150ms for chat flows.

Priya: @Sara renewal is 6 months out — big upside if this goes well but also a risk if we miss perf. pricing sensitivity flagged.

Sara: exactly. they're open to committed pricing if we guarantee throughput or offer a dedicated pool + enablement.

Devon: can we run a perf sim on their sample workload? need to validate ops for KV cache + batching behavior.

Marco: I can run a canary benchmark. please drop their sample payload (or S3) here.

Sara: sent link in DM (s3://orchid-prod-samples/po-batch-2026-03.tar.gz). Also they included a small JS client showing concurrent streams.

capacity-bot: Benchmark job queued (id: 789). ETA ~45m.

Ben: we should also prep an enablement pack for their SREs — short doc on prefix caching, batching, and fallback policies.

Priya: i'll schedule an enablement call with product + their SREs for next week. also will loop in sales for a pricing quote. @Ben any templates we can reuse?

Ben: reuse the "dedicated-onboarding" checklist + add a 15m runbook for rollback and model-variant fallback. snippet we often share: ```yaml
batching: auto
kv_cache: enabled
rollout: canary(10%) -> 50% -> 100%
```

Devon: if benchmark looks clean, propose a staged prod rollout with quantized fallback model for peak hours. That should reduce cost and keep p50.

Marco: preliminary numbers from the canary: p50 ~130ms with batching=auto and KV prefix caching; throughput ~2.1x vs naive. Posting logs to /infra/bench/789.

Sara: this is promising. Priya — can you draft a 6-month committed Dedicated pool proposal with burst options? include SLA targets and training sessions.

Priya: yes. will draft and ping legal for data residency + DPA notes.

Ben: flagged as expansion opp in CRM. 

Sara: thanks team. reconvene after we have the formal proposal and the bench report. :rocket:

Marco: added a note — possible gotcha: very long token sequences in one of their vendors may require more KV shards. if bench shows tail latency, we'll recommend shard tuning.

Sara: noted. sharing with account exec and product.

Priya: scheduling enablement + pricing call for Tues 10am PT. invite shortly.

Sara: perfect — thanks all.
